title: Rejected bodies keep last-known-good; record-level faults reject only the record and raise record drift once
notes: Every body after step 1 is synthetic or a damaged copy of a real body.

Step 5's ALTEF3 3754 is the real record with its issue_datetime moved six minutes later; its other damaged records are copies of WARK04 5436 and ALTK04 2691, plus a synthetic header-only ALTK04 2692. Index 9 doubles the space after 'Issue Time:', and index 10 ends its message with the unpaired surrogate escape \ud800.
Step 7 body is described, not embedded: a valid JSON empty array padded with spaces to 1 MiB + 1 byte.
Step 10 body is described, not embedded: 2,001 copies of one small record, within the byte limit.
